title: Claude Code telemetry
description: Cost, tokens, tool/approval activity (human-vs-policy-approval split made explicit), hooks, MCP servers, plugins, data-retention hygiene and per-engineer spend for Claude Code, sourced from the aiCliOtel collector's forwarded OTLP logs in Loki. Benchmarked against Grafana's own official integration dashboard (grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/25052) and built to match its panel coverage and exceed it (hooks/MCP/plugins/retention have no analogue there); lines-of-code and active-time are the two 25052 panels this dashboard cannot reproduce, and it says so rather than faking them (see this script's own docstring). Generated by scripts/generate_claude_code_dashboard.py -- do not hand-edit; regenerate instead.

links.title: Export PNG
links.tooltip: Full dashboard image; allow up to 3 minutes. Uses the selected time range and filters.

panels.title: Total Cost (24h)
panels.description: sum(sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [24h])). Confirmed live: ~$88.50 in a real 24h window across this org's Claude Code usage.

panels.title: Sessions (7d)
panels.description: count(count by (attributes_session_id) (count_over_time(...[7d]))). Every event carries a real session.id -- a distinct-session count, not a metric counter subject to the Mimir gap this dashboard's docstring documents.

panels.title: User Prompts (24h)
panels.description: sum(count_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="user_prompt" [24h])).

panels.title: Engineers active (7d)
panels.description: count(count by (attributes_user_email) (count_over_time(...[7d]))). Confirmed live: 3 distinct @adorsys.com/personal addresses in a real 7d window -- a small pilot group, not a bug.

panels.title: Daily Cost by Model
panels.description: sum by (attributes_model) (sum_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__interval])). attributes_cost_usd AND attributes_cost_usd_micros are both confirmed emitted (RFC-0003: Claude Code is the one client shipping both USD and µUSD) -- cost_usd used here since no stored value in this repo's own schema is involved (ADR-0008 governs storage, not a read-only Loki panel).

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_model) (sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.description: input/output/cache-creation/cache-read tokens, each sum_over_time(... | unwrap attributes_<kind>_tokens [$__interval]), from api_request lines. All four fields confirmed live together.

panels.title: Token Usage by Model (24h)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_model) (sum_over_time({...} | unwrap attributes_input_tokens [24h])) -- input tokens as the volume proxy.

panels.title: Cost by Model (24h)

panels.title: API Requests by Model (24h)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_model) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="api_request" [24h])).

panels.title: Top tools invoked, over time
panels.description: sum by (attributes_tool_name) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="tool_result" [$__interval])). Confirmed live values: Bash, Edit, Read, Write, ScheduleWakeup, Monitor, WebFetch, ToolSearch, mcp_tool, WebSearch, Agent, AskUserQuestion, TaskStop, SendUserFile.

panels.title: Tool call decisions, by decision AND source
panels.description: sum by (attributes_decision, attributes_source) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="tool_decision" [$__interval])). `source` is the load-bearing dimension: `config` is a sandbox/permission-mode default, NOT an engineer's decision. Confirmed live over 24h: 702 accept/config, 2 accept/user_temporary, 2 reject/config -- 99.4% never reached a human.

panels.title: Code edit decisions (Edit/Write/NotebookEdit), source=config share (7d)
panels.description: (count with source=config) / (count total), both restricted to tool_decision on code-editing tools over 7d. Confirmed live: 12,585 accept/config vs 1 reject/config in the scope checked -- ZERO source=user decisions observed. The closest analogue to 25052's `code_edit_tool.decision`-based Accept Rate panel, but split by source so a near-100% figure here reads as "policy default", not "engineers love what the agent writes".

panels.title: Tool execution success rate, over time
panels.description: sum by (attributes_success) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="tool_result" [$__interval])). A signal Codex's own telemetry does not carry at all (see codex-telemetry.json's own docstring) -- confirmed live: 663 true / 39 false over a real 24h window (94.4%).

panels.title: Invocation source (query_source, 7d)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_query_source) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="assistant_response" [7d])). Independent of app.entrypoint -- confirmed live values: sdk, prompt_suggestion, agent:builtin:general-purpose, web_fetch_apply, web_search_tool, compact. "sdk" dominating (669/726 in the sample checked) means most traffic in this fleet is Agent-SDK-driven, not a human typing at an interactive prompt.

panels.title: User Summary (7d)
panels.description: Sessions, prompts, tool calls, API requests, API errors, cost and tokens, one row per engineer -- joined by attributes_user_email across five independent LogQL aggregations (Grafana's joinByField transform), the equivalent of 25052's own multi-`let` KQL join for the same table.

targets.expr: count by (attributes_user_email) (count by (attributes_user_email, attributes_session_id) (count_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_user_email=~".+" [7d])))

sum by (attributes_user_email) (sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [7d]))

sum by (attributes_user_email) (sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_input_tokens [7d]))

panels.title: Per-User Cost by Model (7d)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_user_email, attributes_model) (sum_over_time({...} | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [7d])) -- both dimensions of the same event, so a single query suffices (no join needed, unlike the User Summary table above).

targets.expr: sum by (attributes_user_email, attributes_model) (sum_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_request" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [7d]))

panels.description: count_over_time({job=~"claude-code-desktop|ai-cli/claude-code|ai-cli/claude-code-desktop"} | json | attributes_event_name="api_error" [$__interval]).

panels.title: Error Details (raw, 7d)
panels.description: A native Loki "Logs" panel -- the raw api_error/tool_result(success=false) lines themselves, not an aggregate. Prompt content is never captured here (redacted at the source).

panels.title: Hook execution outcomes, over time
panels.description: success/blocking/cancelled/non-blocking-error counts, each sum_over_time(... | unwrap attributes_num_<kind> [$__interval]) from hook_execution_complete lines. All four fields confirmed live together.

panels.title: Top hooks, by invocation count (7d)
panels.description: topk(10, sum by (attributes_hook_name) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="hook_execution_complete" [7d]))). Confirmed live: PostToolUse:Bash dominates volume.

panels.title: MCP server connections, by status (7d)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_status) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="mcp_server_connection" [7d])). Confirmed live values: connected, disconnected.

panels.title: MCP server connections, by transport (7d)
panels.description: sum by (attributes_transport_type) (count_over_time({...} | attributes_event_name="mcp_server_connection" [7d])). Confirmed live values: stdio, http.
